title: Graphiti: Hybrid BM25/Vector RRF Fusion, Maximal Marginal Relevance & Shortest-Hop Node Distance Reranking
summary: Graphiti composes BM25 fulltext, dense cosine vector search, and BFS graph traversals via Reciprocal Rank Fusion rrf(results, rank_const=1, min_score=0). Diverse result selection applies L2-normalized Maximal Marginal Relevance mmr(query_vector, candidates, mmr_lambda=0.5, min_score=-2.0) maximizing lambda*(q.c) + (lambda-1)*max_sim(c). Locality-focused retrieval uses node_distance_reranker weighting center_node at 0.1 (score 10.0), 1-hop neighbors at 1.0, and unreachable nodes at infinity (0.0).

references.description: rrf, node_distance_reranker, and mmr implementations over candidate UUIDs and vectors
Search configuration defaults combining rerankers and score thresholds

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Fuse heterogeneous sparse/dense/graph rankings using Reciprocal Rank Fusion, balance novelty vs relevance via MMR, and score graph neighborhood centrality by inverse hop distance.
